newsitem.title: ANGOLA: Angolan leader in first official visit to Angola.
newsitem.headline: Angolan leader in first official visit to Angola.

text.p: Brazilian President Fernando Henrique Cardoso arrived in the Angolan capital Luanda on Sunday for his first official visit to the country.

Cardoso, accompanied by a large government and military delegation, was met at Luanda's International Airport by Angolan Foreign Minister Venancio de Moura and United Nations mediator to Angola, Alioune Blondin Beye.

He was immediately taken to the presidential palace outside Luanda for a meeting with the Brazilian community living in Angola, the southern African country tied to Brazil through the Portuguese language.

On Monday, Cardoso will meet Angolan President Jose Eduardo dos Santos and they are expected to sign a cooperation aagrement. Hours later he is due to fly to the war-torn town of Cuito in Bie province where he will meet Brazilian peacekeepers helping to implement a two-year-old peace accord on the ground.
Cordoso heads to South Africa on Monday evening, the first visit to the country by a Brazilian leader.
